payload.title: Count structural marginal unit gains by obligation-qualified evidence rather than new resource alone
payload.summary: Priority3 versioned-analysis correctness. Nested marginal computes new_required_unit_judgments only when a required unit resource is in delta_resources AND its obligation/resource cell is new. A resource already present for ob-a that becomes correctly supported for ob-b gains a required cell and unit judgment but reports zero unit gain. Exact source function with independent two-obligation fixture reproduces it. All three retained Case0008 marginal unit counts agree with retained surface differences; no original numeric impact demonstrated.
payload.benefit: Leave frozen source/reports unchanged. In a versioned future projection/verifier, derive added obligation/unit judgments from qualified before/after support sets, separately derive globally distinct-unit and unique-resource gains, and label each denominator explicitly. Tests include same resource under a new obligation, same unit already covered elsewhere, duplicate supports, overlapping operators, no changes, missing/unknown units and foreign frame. Authenticate actual retained schemas and pair identities; accept unchanged historical marginals without suggesting a new retrieval result. Keep gold in evaluation only.
payload.uncertainty: Synthetic generality defect, not evidence of a wrong original Case0008 verdict or native RI error. Shared metrics helpers need caller/schema compatibility; no generic evaluator or rewriting independent scientific controls.
